BiblicalUsage: Gath-rimmon = "winepress of the pomegranate"; 1) a city given out of the tribe of Dan to the Levites, situated on the plain of Philistia, apparently not far from Joppa; 2) a town of the half tribe of Manasseh located on the west side of the Jordan, assigned to the Levites
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
